paper_title: Are Large Language Models Really Good Logical Reasoners A Comprehensive   Evaluation and Beyond
caption: Visualization on the metric of answer correctness.
model_annotation: This chart depicts the accuracy scores of three large language models, Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD, across two distinct tasks: classification and generation. The horizontal axis displays the model names – Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD – arranged in alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with values marked linearly and incremented by 0.05.  Each model is represented by a stack of colored bars; the blue bar for Davinci-003 has an accuracy of approximately 0.78, the green bar for ChatGPT has an accuracy of approximately 0.72, and the yellow bar for BARD has an accuracy of approximately 0.65. The bars are stacked, with the bottom representing classification and the top representing generation.  The color gradient visually transitions from blue (lower accuracy) to yellow (higher accuracy) within the stack for each model, providing a nuanced representation of performance across the two tasks. No bars are specifically emphasized or shaded in this visualization.
